sloka: तरूणां च शिलानां च शस्त्राणां चातिदारुणम् ।यमसैन्येषु तद्वर्षं पपात धरणीतले ।। ७.२१.३६ ॥
transliteration: tarūṇāṁ ca śilānāṁ ca śastrāṇāṁ cātidāruṇam ।yamasainyeṣu tadvarṣaṁ papāta dharaṇītale ।। 7.21.36 ॥

translations.english: That extremely terrible shower of trees, stones, and weapons fell upon Yama's armies on the surface of the earth.
